title: Implement immutable sibling version lifecycle
goal: Stage verify select and roll back operator-supplied RID packages with durable receipts and compatibility-gated downgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: Operator-supplied packages stage into verified immutable version/RID siblings.
Selection changes only after certification and preserves the previous verified sibling until completion.
Interrupted selection is restart-safe and rollback is explicit and receipted.
Downgrade fails closed when retained context or state schemas are incompatible.
No discovery download background activation release or remote change occurs.
risks: Downgrade could make retained state unreadable.
decisions: Use operator-supplied immutable siblings and an external atomic selection receipt.
